Asturian.reason: Asturian refers to a human language used as a target in the FLEURS ASR experiments and evaluated with SeqStack.

Assamese.reason: Assamese refers to a human language used as a target in the FLEURS ASR experiments and evaluated with SeqStack.

Swahili.reason: Swahili refers to a human language used as source-language data and an empirically related proxy in the Xhosa transfer experiments.

Zulu.reason: Zulu refers to a human language whose adapter is trained and evaluated as the closest source for Xhosa.

Bengali.reason: Bengali refers to a human language used as the closest source language for the Assamese transfer experiments.

French.reason: French refers to a human language used as a candidate source whose adapter and transfer performance are evaluated for Asturian.

Spanish.reason: Spanish refers to a human language used as source-language data and a proxy for the Asturian transfer experiments.

Xhosa.reason: Xhosa refers to a human language used as a target in the FLEURS ASR experiments and evaluated with SeqStack.

Hindi.reason: Hindi refers to a human language used as a candidate source whose adapter is trained and evaluated for Assamese transfer.

Latin.reason: Latin refers to a script class used to categorize Unicode token coverage, not the Latin language.
